thread:
noah kim: quick heads-up from the VPN lab: two persistent items on the Private setup networking step. 1) probes frequently timeout behind corporate VPNs (looks like TCP resets) and the UI shows a single "Network check failed" line with no guidance. 2) the CIDR validator rejects compressed IPv6 notation like fd00::/64 in some locales (users typed fd00::/64 and got "invalid CIDR"). also the success toast is icon-only (green check) which has poor contrast and screenreader silence. can we triage copy + behavioral fixes?
maia nguyen: thanks. for the VPN case we should surface a short troubleshooting path inline: "If you're on a VPN, try disabling split-tunnel or whitelist the installer IPs. See help article." link to KB in a small help pill. For the CIDR validator, we should accept all standard IPv6 compressed forms and show a short example set. Inline helper: "CIDR examples: 10.0.0.0/16, fd00::/64, 2001:db8::/32".
jamal taylor: accessibility + behavior: probes behind VPNs often produce interleaved errors. UX changes: 1) change generic "Network check failed" to actionable states (e.g., "Probe timed out", "Connection reset"). 2) add an expandable "Why this failed" panel with suggested remediation steps. 3) for toasts: add visible text and role=alert so SRs announce final outcomes. Also we need aria-live on the streaming log area so updates don't steal focus.
sasha chen: for the CIDR validator bug have we logged the exact regex? if it's too strict it might be rejecting zero-compression. jamal, can you add a test case for fd00::/64 and ::1/128?
jamal taylor: yes adding tests. quick validator fix (JS pseudo):

```
// allow IPv4 and IPv6 CIDR (simple version)
const cidrRegex = /^(?:\d{1,3}(?:\.\d{1,3}){3}\/\d{1,2}|[0-9a-fA-F:]+\/\d{1,3})$/;
```

We should reuse a library (ipaddr.js) for robust parsing rather than hand-rolled regex. i'll add that to the validation util.
maia nguyen: microcopy suggestions: 
- Inline helper: "Control-plane CIDR (e.g., 10.0.0.0/16, fd00::/64). Ask your network owner if unsure."
- VPN help pill copy: "On VPN? Try whitelisting installer IPs or disable split-tunnel. Learn more."
- Failure state copy (short): "Probe timed out  Check firewall/VPN rules." (with a "See suggested fixes" link).

sasha chen: UX details: for the probe list on narrow viewports the verbose logs push the form offscreen. propose default compact rows + a per-probe "expand logs" to reveal streaming output. add a "Preserve logs" toggle so support can capture them across runs. Also ensure expanding doesn't trap focus.
jamal taylor: focus-handling plan: capture opener button, focus drawer header on open, and on close restore opener.focus(). Also make the drawer non-modal (allow tab to flow past) unless user explicitly pins it. snippet: 

```
const opener = document.activeElement;
openDetails();
closeDetails();
opener?.focus?.();
```

Add aria-controls, aria-expanded on the opener and role=region + aria-labelledby on the details panel.
design-bot: uploaded screenshot: https://files.redwood.ai/ux/vpn-probe-timeout-202608.png :camera_with_flash: shows the compact list with a "Why failed" flyout.
maia nguyen: tweak for toasts: instead of tiny green circle use a full text toast: "Connectivity verified  4/4 checks passed" with a subtle icon and 4.5:1 contrast. final-state toast should be focusable for SR users (temporarily) or we use role=alert. agree with role=alert + visible text.
sasha chen: action items: jamal will land validator tests + switch to ipaddr.js, jamal also implements focus restore + aria attributes; maia will update inline copy + VPN help pill + failure microcopy; andrew (cc'ed) can you adjust the compact default and add Preserve logs toggle (won't ping him here but we'll include in the ticket). i'll open a follow-up e2e that reproduces VPN timeout via mocked resets. target: include in next minor release. thanks all :thumbsup:
